- sp hybridization: 2 regions of electron density (linear geometry)

- sp³ hybridization: 4 regions of electron density (tetrahedral)

- In alcohols, the oxygen atom is bonded to one carbon atom and one hydrogen atom
- The oxygen also has two lone pairs of electrons

- 1 bond to carbon
- 1 bond to hydrogen
- 2 lone pairs of electrons

This gives a total of 4 regions of electron density around the oxygen atom, which corresponds to sp³ hybridization.
